column1: # Candidate record: work implemented but not yet accepted on main (ROADMAP "Implemented, not yet accepted").
# The roadmap table is GENERATED from this file by scripts/gen/candidate_table.py --write; editing the
# table by hand fails check_docs_drift.sh. Whoever lands, re-points or validates a candidate updates its
# row in the same commit and regenerates. A row leaves when its work is accepted on main.
# Columns (tab-separated, every cell non-empty, "-" for none):
#   id         short stable name of the candidate
#   bugs       comma-separated three-digit bug numbers the candidate fixes, or "-"
#   deliverable the feature deliverable it implements, or "-" (a row names bugs or a deliverable)
#   branch     the branch holding the candidate
#   sha        the full 40-hex candidate commit (git rev-parse <branch> when recorded)
#   exits      the Phase 1 exits it contributes to (bug fixes) or that block its acceptance (deliverables)
#   stage_a stage_b stage_c   promotion-pipeline results: "not-run", or "passed@<sha>" / "failed@<sha>"
#              with an optional " run=<CI run id>"; a result must be at this row's sha (a stale result is
#              reset to not-run when the sha moves); stage (c) passed needs a run id and stage (b) passed
#   unlocks    the next deliverable or exit its acceptance unlocks
#   remaining  the remaining acceptance step
